title: Elderscrolls Morrowind Mods Map
creditMorrowind: by Bethesda Softworks. The landscape, its textures and every place name of Morrowind and Bloodmoon come from the game.
creditTamrielRebuilt: by the Tamriel Rebuilt team: the Morrowind mainland.
creditProjectTamriel: by the Project Tamriel team: Project Cyrodiil and Skyrim: Home of the Nords.
creditTamrielData: by the Tamriel Rebuilt and Project Tamriel teams: the textures their lands use.
creditTotsp: by Wollirollo and others: Solstheim remade.
creditWyrmhaven: by Neoptolemus: an island west of Solstheim.
creditWhiteWolf: by Emma and TeuTonic: Lokken island.
creditAzurian: by Melchior Dahrk: islands between Tamriel and Akavir.
creditOaabData: the textures and models the Azurian Isles use.
creditTamriel: the landmass of the whole continent, drawn where the other mods have no land yet.
creditRussianMorrowind: in Russian, by 1C: the Russian names of Morrowind and Bloodmoon.
creditRussianMods: the Russian names of the mods.
creditTes3: by Greatness7: the library that reads the plugin and archive files.
creditsNote: This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Bethesda Softworks or the mod teams. The map images and place names belong to their authors.
